Military escalation | Turkish missile shelling kills civilian in Manbij countryside

Aleppo province: SOHR activists have documented the death of a civilian in Turkish missile shelling on Jarad village in northern Manbij countryside eastern of Aleppo.

On June 29, SOHR activists documented the death of two civilians due to artillery fire carried out by Turkish forces deployed in “Euphrates Shield” area on the outskirts of Arab Hassan village in north Manbij countryside in the eastern countryside of Aleppo.
